briefdescription.para: Forward iterator over the terms of a ResPolynomial.

detaileddescription.para: Carries two cursors: coeff_index ticks through elem.coeffs one per term, and monom_index walks the flat elem.monoms buffer in monomial-size strides (ResMonoid::monomial_size), which is variable when monomials are not fixed-width. Equality compares the coefficient index only the "end" iterator pins it to elem.len.
